answer: Require every agent to lock a copper-backed stake before it can earn, with the stake released only after a long season of honest work. A newcomer cannot simply spawn thousands of clones, because each clone needs its own locked stake and its own track record, like boats queuing at a single jetty rather than one ship pretending to be a fleet. Old, proven work becomes a relic of trust that cannot be copied: an attacker must pay real cost per identity and wait, so faking scale stops being cheap.
